remarks: Stunning, updated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo in the sought-after Ledgebrook community. This bright, spacious unit showcases vaulted wood-beam ceilings, modern quartz countertops, and serene water views. The remodeled kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and ample counter space, perfect for the home chef. The primary bedroom offers generous closet space, a private powder room, and additional storage. The inviting living room is the heart of the home, with a floor-to-ceiling white brick fireplace, Lutron light filtering automated window blinds with remote, and access to a balcony with peaceful water views. This unit is ready for its next owner. Conveniently located just 5 miles from Metro North, a short drive to Post Road, with easy access to I-95 and the vibrant SoNo area. Don't miss this incredible opportunity-schedule your showing today!
